---
title: "New slide scanner"
date: 2023-06-01
author: Vlad Popovici
image: ../media/news/2023-06-01-new-slide-scanner.jpg
---

Starting this month, we have a new scanner to support our histopathology
image analysis projects. This is a 3D Histech
[scanner](https://www.3dhistech.com/research/pannoramic-digital-slide-scanners/pannoramic-midi/)
for small-to-medium throughput but producing high quality images both in
brightfield and fluorescence modalities.
